title: Hybrid quantum-classical algorithms for complex nonlinear partial differential equations with Ginzburg-Landau potential and vortex motion laws
summary: We propose quantum algorithms for complex-valued nonlinear partial differential equations in the strongly nonlinear regime, where the dynamics is governed by vortex cores, phase singularities, and nonlinear vortex interactions. Examples include the complex-valued nonlinear Schrödinger equation, as well as nonlinear heat and wave equations with Ginzburg--Landau-type nonlinearity.
